$comment: EAR1-F3: the listening models, hosted on 2026-11-07 (compose-provisional.mjs SOURCES; their plans are hosting/plan/listen.mjs, in PLAN), with the four text-bank files the audio builds carry at listen-text/<sha12>/<file>. CLAP's audio and text encoders and AST, each an int8 base (the CPU build) whose fp16 variant requires darwin and Metal (ONNX Runtime's WebGPU provider). All on demand (tiers []); every build depends on onnxruntime (compose-provisional.mjs adds it). Built by tools/components/listen/pack-listen-models.mjs: hosting/build.mjs --pending with the pack recipe, layout "file" (sorted names, ustar, uid 0, gid 0, mode 0644, mtime 0, the tar written to a file, then zstd 1.5.7 -19 -T1); two packs on 2026-11-06 gave the same sha256 (the audio builds again with the text banks, as -text1). Each archive is flat: the graph as model.onnx beside the upstream configs, unchanged (tools/components/listen/README.md).
